title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1916: Chaos race (2)

section.p: Stable Army Marquis’ expression changed drastically as he pushed all his power into his spear and roared, “You dare?”
Golden Dragon Marquis was a peak existence, yet he had resorted to self-detonation. He was doing this just to kill them. He was trying to drag some of them down with him before dying.

He knew that he would definitely die the moment Su Yu and Great Zhou King arrived. The two wouldn’t even need much effort to kill him. Since fleeing was impossible, he might as well use his very life to kill one or even more of his enemies.

Realizing what was happening, Stable Army Marquis was alarmed. He was the strongest individual in the group. Su Yu had reminded him that they were only here to keep Golden Dragon Marquis busy. Killing was not their priority, and none of them was allowed to die. He would be punished for any casualty.
And Golden Dragon Marquis had opted to detonate himself.
Stable Army Marquis had never expected this. The ancient dragon marquis was too decisive.
He couldn’t even react.
He was in deep trouble.

As the explosion hit him, his spear was blasted apart along with more than half his body. He roared madly as he resisted the explosion. The others also acted alongside him. The expressions of Su Yu and Great Zhou King changed as well. They hurriedly acted.
After a while, calm returned.

The rest were mostly fine, but Stable Army Marquis was left with only half his body, and a ruined weapon. He looked at Su Yu with his deathly pale face and said helplessly, “I did not expect his self-detonation. I was too careless.”

That was a tier-two Daofuse. How could someone like that self-detonate so easily? If it wasn’t for the numerical superiority on their side, he would have died to that explosion. And if it wasn’t for his efforts, Chong Ming, who had just broken through, would definitely die. Despite having blocked the impact of the explosion, he was heavily injured.
Su Yu frowned slightly, but he soon unfurrowed his brows as he said, “You did well. Nobody expected that.”
Self-detonation was unstoppable unless one was far stronger than the person doing so.
“Can you still move?”

“Yes.” After taking a short moment to regrow his flesh, Stable Army Marquis said softly, “But my strength has dropped significantly. In my current state, I won’t be a match for even a tier-five Daofuse.”
The injuries on him were very severe.
“Don’t worry about it.” Su Yu said, “Clean up the Eternals, destroy the city, and snatch their treasures.”
Then, Su Yu grabbed Great Ming King before teleporting toward the dragon head with Great Zhou King. He took Great Ming King because Great Ming King’s formation specialty would be required there.

It would be too dangerous to have others participate in a battle with a heavenly king. Great Zhou King, Lan Tian, and he would be enough to defeat such an opponent. At this point, only two minutes had passed since the start of the attack. They still had some time left. In fact, Golden Dragon Marquis had bought them some time through his self-detonation.
“Golden Dragon!”

Blood Dragon Marquis roared with despair and indignation. It was over! Golden Dragon Marquis was dead! As for Blood Dragon Marquis himself, he had no way of breaking free from the lunatic he was facing.

Of the seven Daofuses stationed in their territory, there was a heavenly king, and there was also a peak Daofuse. Yet they had been defeated so easily. Apart from himself and Wind Dragon, the rest had died. Blood Dragon Marquis couldn’t accept this. He wanted to flee, but not even fleeing was possible.

Lan Tian might have newly pioneered his dao, but his dao was long and powerful. He was someone who had reached the level of a heavenly king right after pioneering his dao. It was clear just how powerful his all-life dao was.

Blood Dragon Marquis could feel that his dao had been completely tangled with Lan Tian’s dao. In fact, the two were slowly becoming one. Fleeing was impossible. But fighting seemed hopeless as the lunatic seemed to have an endless number of clones. It was as though he was fighting someone unkillable.
“Just who are you?”

Blood Dragon Marquis asked with a tired and indignant voice. He could sense the spatial fluctuations. Unsurprisingly, three individuals appeared near him moments later. One instantly vanished into the void to lay down a formation to block him from escaping. Then again, that did not seem necessary.
Wait, was that…a concealment formation? Was there a need for that?
Once again, Blood Dragon Marquis engaged Lan Tian in battle while asking, “Who are you?”

He roared again without waiting for a reply, “You’re from Chaos Mountain. Am I right? You are the same group of people as the one who had betrayed and helped Hundred Battle. Am I right? Sure enough, you can’t resist revealing yourselves anymore. Do you think that the myriad races are really clueless about your existence? In the past, we knew too little about your group. Now that you have revealed more clues about your group, it is only a matter of time before you’re all hunted down by the myriad races!”

He was feeling both despair and indignation, but there was still a tiny bit of hope in his voice as he said, “Release me and I’ll cooperate with you! The dragon race is powerful both in the Dao Origin Land and the Lower Realm! As long as you release me, you will receive the cooperation of the dragon race. We are not the divines, immortals, or devils. We are incapable of dominating the Myriad Realms. It doesn’t matter who we submit to. Release me and you will receive our submission.”
To survive, he was willing to submit to these people.

Step after step, Su Yu approached him with a look of contempt. He said, “We don’t need your submission. We are not interested in trash. Our race is destined to unify all of existence and recreate a new world. We are unlike the foolish humans. You can call us the chaos race.”
Chaos race.
Blood Dragon Marquis was greatly shocked to hear that. He could feel that this person was a human.
But this person was claiming to be a part of the chaos race.
Just who was this person?

Looking at the formation around them and the chaos power Su Yu and Lan Tian were emitting, he said solemnly, “Chaos race? How ridiculous. You are merely the traitors of humanity. Just like us. What a joke.”

Su Yu coldly said, “Ignorant fool. You will never understand the greatness of our lineage. Our lineage has been incomparably noble since the ancient past. And today, no lineage is more noble than ours. It’s time for you to die.”

With a roar by Su Yu, Great Zhou King released the power of his dao while Su Yu charged straight ahead. He was attacking head-on without any tricks. With that, Su Yu and Lan Tian started attacking while Great Zhou King ran interference further away. Intense dao fluctuations rippled out.
A heavenly king was not easy to kill. Thus, Su Yu and Lan Tian were forced to use all their strength.

Blood Dragon Marquis was coughing blood endlessly, with all his claws broken and his tail severed. However, he was still capable of displaying an incredible level of combat strength. One Lan Tian after another was killed, and wound after wound was left on Su Yu’s body.
Su Yu continued the battle while waiting for something. Finally, his eyes lit up. Out of nowhere, a pen appeared in his hand.
Blood Dragon Marquis blanked out for a moment before fear and fury covered his eyes. “No! You lied to me!”
Culture King.
This was someone from Culture King’s lineage!
Not the so-called chaos race!
Knowing that he wouldn’t survive, he had used a special method to record some information in their surroundings using a special method.

p.emphasis: Chaos race, chaos power, and concealment formation.

section.p: Those were the keywords he had left behind. Any experts from the dragon race would be able to uncover his message. Naturally, an outsider wouldn’t be able to find anything. But the moment he saw Su Yu’s pen, he knew that he had been lied to.
These people were probably not from the so-called chaos race. Rather, they were from Culture King’s lineage. They were using him to mislead the myriad races.
“It’s too late.”
With his pen dao in hand, Su Yu grew even stronger than before. Meanwhile, Blood Dragon Marquis had already weakened considerably.
The pen shot forth.
A crack rang out.
The pen struck the dragon’s dao, leaving a crack on it.
In response, the dao hurriedly moved away. But it was too slow for Su Yu, someone capable of seeing daos clearly. He proceeded to stab his pen forth dozens of times.
With a rumble, the dao crumbled.

The destruction of the dao generated a large backlash on Blood Dragon Marquis’ body. Instantly, his body fell apart, revealing a fleeing sea of willpower. With a smile, Great Zhou King stretched out and grabbed the ball of light. With a bang, the ball was crushed.

A storm of dao power swept through the entire north of the Upper Realm. Countless dao fluctuations swept out. It was as though a dao fireworks had been set off. Yes. This was how death phenomena looked like in the Upper Realm. The stronger the dead expert, the more brilliant the fireworks would be.
Far away.

The phoenix expert, who had just reached the dragon tail, hurriedly turned around to flee in fear. An expert at the level of a heavenly king had fled without hesitation. She would still have the courage to fight with Blood Dragon Marquis. But with Blood Dragon Marquis, she would be a complete fool to continue ahead.
Her roar rang out throughout the phoenix territory, “All Daofuses, assemble! All Eternals, assemble! Now!”

They had to defend themselves now. Something major had happened. The dragons had lost six Daofuses instantly. Apart from Wind Dragon, who had escaped, all had died. Even Blood Dragon Marquis had died. The phoenix experts were all panicking.
The dragon race was very powerful. In fact, it was slightly more powerful than the phoenix race. Yet it had been defeated just like that.
Su Yu ignored the phoenix race.
Instead, he was devouring everything he saw with the Mark of Civilization.
Looking at the dragons who were fleeing everywhere, his eyes turned cold as he said, “Kill. Plunder their riches. Make haste.”
At his order, the human experts scattered.
Miserable wails rang out everywhere. A group of Daofuses was killing a bunch of Eternals. This was too easy for them.
A short while later, the large Blood Dragon City was flattened.
They killed everyone they could.
A large amount of treasures were plundered. Numerous treasure vaults were pried open. There were so many treasures in these vaults that the entire area was brightened by the glint of these treasures.

Countless dragons could be seen escaping in all directions. A short while later, Skyeater arrived and opened his mouth. The entire ruined city was devoured. As for the Golden Dragon City, it had been flattened even earlier than that.

The Daofuses grouped up again. Then, Great Zhou King teleported them to the other cities one after another. Before long, the eighth minute since the start of the attack arrived. That was how long it had taken them to wreak the entire dragon territory.
Looking into the distance, Su Yu said, “Withdraw.”
One dragon city remained, and many Eternals were still alive. But they couldn’t afford to stay any longer. Su Yu could see several dao projections approaching from afar.
Heavenly kings.

Heavenly kings were approaching, and some felt even stronger than Blood Dragon Marquis. To be precise, three dao projections were approaching them. Including the phoenix, four experts at the level of heavenly kings would arrive soon. What could they do but leave?

Great Zhou King, who was panting heavily, hurriedly started another teleportation while Su Yu calmed the fluctuations around them with his stone. While doing so, he laughed in amusement and said, “Stop panting. Why are you still acting here?”
“It’s real this time!”
Great Zhou King rolled his eyes. He wasn’t acting.
This was real.
Fuck!
Why was this guy so paranoid? How many times had he teleported today? Did this bastard believe that he was made of iron or something?

The others were also panting in exhaustion. September, with his greatly enlarged belly, opened his mouth and freed a dragon accidentally. He hurriedly chomped down before speaking with his mouth shut, “I’m so full! I’m bursting apart! Emperor Yu, let’s go! I need to find a place to digest all this!”
